essence: Once the mantra is perfected, the mantra-holder may proceed to perform its applications.
In this application one should strike without hesitation or deliberation.
The application is set in a martial context marked by flags, banners, and drums.
The mantra causes the enemy to be bewildered in battle, so the practitioner indeed gains victory.
The mantra is formed by uttering tārā and namaḥ as before.
